_comment: Portable MCP definition for Wikifier. The actual launcher requires a per-machine 'pip install -e "[mcp]"' (Python >=3.10) on the host where Grok runs. Grok user config (~/.grok/config.toml) takes precedence for the same server name.

wikifier.description: Wikifier - agent-to-agent codebase wiki (install per-machine with python3 -m pip install -e '.[mcp]' using a Python >= 3.10, then set WIKIFIER_PROJECT_ROOT or pass project_root=)
